gen.multi.dry-regen-power.rootCause: evaluateRequiredFact + hasConflictingAlternateNumeric treated a second watt figure in the same answer as contradiction for each required W fact, so 40 W and 540 W could not both pass.
gen.multi.dry-regen-power.fix: Structural pair detection isDualDryRegenWFactPair (exactly two pure numeric W facts 40+540). hasConflictingAlternateNumeric exempts the partner value only when alternateExemptDryRegenDualW ties each number to the correct mode clause (drying vs regeneration), excluding «осушителя» in «регенерации осушителя».

gen.note.height-signal.rootCause: GroundingEvidenceSegments were single-line only; footnote split across two lines never contained the regex без\s+учета as one substring.
gen.note.height-signal.fix: buildGroundingEvidenceSegments concatenates adjacent lines as pair and triple segments for prompt chunks and extract corpus excerpt.

gen.rh.rule-above30.fix: extractSatisfiesQuery(rh_setpoint_rule): require 20 with offset phrasing or rh%окр context. priorAnswerFullyAnswersQuery(power_dry_regen): require осуш + регенерац with 40 and 540.
